Plan-posture adjudication:

- R1 is construction-ready. It replaces basename membership with one sealed-predicate/exact-identity cutoff oracle, gives the pre-cutoff omitted `coder.ts` counterexample through that same path, and bounds the change to the existing verifier.
- R3 is construction-ready. One append-only Recorder successor owns independent execution and attribution; the existing verifier remains the sole regression verifier. The Plan identifies immutable Git tuples, scanner-byte verification before execution, 277 external source seals without raw duplication, child failure gates, and preservation scope.
- R4 is construction-ready. Its red/green gates cover ledger seals, source/scanner/report drift, historical identities, the repair-002 seals, focused test/typecheck, and refusal on identity loss.
- R2 remains a Plan blocker. “Traverse nested JSON values and Markdown/text” and “recognize issue/PR references and full/uniquely resolvable commit identities” do not define a deterministic bounded oracle. Apply would still have to choose which JSON keys and string contexts are authoritative; which Markdown/text forms and repository namespace establish an issue or PR; whether persisted `issuePrCommitAssociations` fields are excluded from derivation rather than making the comparison tautological; which sealed repository/commit universe resolves short OIDs; and which contextual forms distinguish commit associations from arbitrary prose or hexadecimal tokens. Current admitted bytes demonstrate why this matters: `commitOid`/`reviewedHead` occur both as structural values and as prose discussing those field names.

Smallest correction: revise R2 Behavior/Red/Green to state one closed grammar and source universe. It must enumerate the accepted issue/PR/commit forms for basenames, Markdown/text, recursive JSON keys/string values, and Git-reference bytes; bind issue/PR and short-commit resolution to explicit sealed repository inputs; exclude the association fields being validated from derivation; reject unlabeled numbers, unrelated prose, and unqualified hex; canonicalize/deduplicate exact results; and add negative boundary cases through the same extractor/comparator. Keep the already-planned real second-item field/input mutation through that comparator.

Freshness is not blocking: current HEAD is clean; all four historical commits exist and are ancestors; all 597 current `/tmp` identities are present with unchanged lstat metadata; all 277 admitted non-generic source hashes match; the four historical blob/SHA pairs re-resolve; and repair-002’s implementation/result seals remain `fd219ea9…` and `654fdff4…`.

fix.summary: Amend R2 only: freeze a closed association-recognition grammar and its negative boundary so Apply does not decide what prose, JSON fields, issue/PR forms, repositories, or hex tokens count.
